# Google Images

*Product*

Google's image search, which shows images from the web with a link to the page that hosts them.

Narrative: the topic [Images](../topics/images.md) tells the story; this card lists what links to it.

8 claims mention it: 2 from Google's documentation, 2 shown or said at the event (1 not in Google docs, 1 consistent with Google docs), 4 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [Google image SEO best practices](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/google-images), [Image metadata in Google Images](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/image-license-metadata).

- [`D2-C554`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Docs: Google's video SEO guide says a video must be embedded on an indexed watch page to be eligible for video features and recommends a dedicated watch page per video where it makes sense for the business; a non-watch page with the video can still appear as a text result or a Google Images result with a video badge. `[D2-C554, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/video]`
- [`D2-C943`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Docs: Google's image metadata guide says Google Images supports the IPTC Digital Source Type values for algorithmically created images, such as trainedAlgorithmicMedia, and can show C2PA details in 'About this image', such as whether an image was created or edited with AI tools. `[D2-C943, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/image-license-metadata]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D3-C319`](../sessions/D3-S10-how-search-results-are-born.md) Stage, Day 3, not in Google docs: Image results shown among web results come from Google's image index and are roughly the same images that Google Images shows for the same query. `[D3-C319, stage, Google, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C345`](../sessions/D3-S10-how-search-results-are-born.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: Product annotations on Google Images results also come from product structured data and do not need Google Merchant Center. `[D3-C345, stage, Google, Day 3]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D1-C200`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Analysis: Visual search predates transformers in Google's own history: its Search timeline dates Google Images to 2001 and Google Lens to 2017, the year Google Research published the Transformer, so read the stage remark as being about today's multimodal AI search. `[D1-C200, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D2-C538`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Analysis: Images that should rank need an img element with a real src; hero or product images set as CSS backgrounds are invisible to Google Images and image features, so keep CSS backgrounds for decorative images you do not need indexed. `[D2-C538, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D2-C545`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Analysis: While the AVIF ingestion hiccup Gary Illyes mentioned lasts, serve AVIF only through source elements inside picture and keep a WebP or JPEG file in the img src, which is the URL Google extracts, even though Google's documentation lists AVIF as supported; then check in Google Images that key images appear. `[D2-C545, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D3-C351`](../sessions/D3-S10-how-search-results-are-born.md) Analysis: For an online shop, Product structured data is enough for product rich results and Google Images product annotations, but the Shopping tab needs a Merchant Center feed too; keep feed and markup values identical, since Google can use the markup to validate the feed. `[D3-C351, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`

## For developers

- `DEV-IMG-08` **MAY** · Documented: Keep the IPTC and C2PA metadata that marks AI-generated images (1 of its claims mentions it; its own text names it)
- `DEV-SHP-01` **SHOULD** · Documented: Use Product markup for rich results and a Merchant Center feed for the Shopping tab, with identical values (2 of its claims mention it; its own text names it)
